checks.name: surface-type-check-before-emission
checks.detail: every emitted declaration passes LeanRustCore.Surface.checkSurfaceFun before Rust source is produced

checks.name: snapshot-reproducibility
checks.detail: scripts/check-extractor-snapshot.sh diffs generated.rs, differential tests, compatibility report, validation report, and build metadata against Lean output

checks.name: lean-evaluator-differential-tests
checks.detail: rust/tests/differential_generated.rs compares generated Rust calls with expectations computed by LeanRustCore.IR.eval and LeanRustCore.Surface.evalSurfaceFun

checks.name: safe-rust-subset-gate
checks.detail: scripts/check-rust-validation.sh rejects unsafe, extern boundaries, panic/todo/unimplemented calls, and malformed emitter markers in generated Rust

checks.name: ffi-boundary-exclusion
checks.detail: the direct Lean-emits-Rust path emits ordinary safe Rust only; raw FFI remains outside this compiler path

checks.name: payload-enum-match-lowering
checks.detail: payload enum matches lower through checked branch binders and Rust variant patterns

checks.name: first-order-call-lowering
checks.detail: calls to tagged first-order Lean declarations lower to checked Rust function calls and dependency-aware emission

checks.name: surface-evaluator-extracted-subset-tests
checks.detail: the SurfaceExpr evaluator covers the current extracted struct, enum, Result, monomorphization, payload-match, and call fixtures

checks.name: rust-identifier-hygiene
checks.detail: Rust identifiers are sanitized for ASCII Rust syntax, keywords are escaped or prefixed, type/variant names use UpperCamelCase, and generated modules are checked for post-sanitization collisions before emission

checks.name: exact-toolchain-pins
checks.detail: Lean toolchain leanprover/lean4:v4.22.0 and Rust toolchain 1.85.0 are pinned and checked by scripts/check-toolchain-pins.sh

checks.name: release-fallback-ban
checks.detail: rust/build.rs refuses checked-in generated.rs fallback for CI or release builds; local development fallback requires LEAN_RUST_CORE_ALLOW_FALLBACK=1

checks.name: automatic-monomorphization
checks.detail: generic calls discovered inside concrete exported declarations enqueue and emit concrete monomorphized Rust functions before their callers

checks.name: syn-parser-backed-validation
checks.detail: rust/tests/parser_validation.rs parses generated.rs with syn and validates the approved top-level safe Rust subset by AST instead of relying only on text grep
